mechanisms.fsync: Sync original file data, then only its retained owning filesystem namespace if linked. Anonymous/unlinked data keeps its sync but has no namespace entry. Detached mounts retain their owner; named persistent checkpoint errors remain observable.
mechanisms.wayland: Cache validated grants in real SharedFiles membership under its existing object mutex. Every owner/worker membership mutation retires inactive grants immediately. Native service identity and connection generation handle topology changes; compositor inode registration remains live.
mechanisms.proc: Resolve actual proc dependencies through aliases, then union exact payload bits. Mapping text, environment and auxiliary data are produced only on demand. Combining descriptor traversal and another payload no longer promotes the query to all fields. Mutable argument bytes remain live when requested.

resource_projection_follow_up.diagnostic_limits: Five-second all-thread samples in separate diagnostic visits. Reported counts are inclusive coordinator wall-stack observations, not process CPU percentages or matched-work speed ratios. The field-set diagnostic precedes the final FD-cache ownership correction; its proc implementation is identical.

validation.negative_control: Omitting inactive grant retirement from the final membership mutation path fails the worker-close regression. Production source is restored byte-for-byte before validation/build.

limits: Three ordered formal observations per site; no randomized pairs or confidence intervals.
Dynamic site responses and HTTP/DNS/CDN caches remain uncontrolled.
DOM-marker readiness does not mean complete subresource loading, pixel presentation or interactive/video latency.

Persistent-root full manifest serialization/durable commit and memory-view preparation remain on their existing joined paths.
The in-app browser was not remeasured.

conditions.metric: click-command start to site-specific DOM content marker; not complete loading, presentation, or video playback

mechanisms: Separate stable resident file data metadata domains from executable content domains. Real size/layout/source changes still invalidate aliases; ordinary byte visibility uses retained canonical SharedPage storage.
Use the selected domain for range hints. Resident data writes need zero per-page checks and hardware-frame refreshes; executable aliases keep their changed-offset history.

Park eligible ordinary PlainFile fsync/fdatasync callers on the existing bounded disk I/O worker pool, retaining owned resources and synchronous durability/error semantics. No new service/wait thread or polling bus.
Serialize concurrent manifest construction/commit per actual disk store; no global byte-I/O lock. Joined structural work still drains submitted disk jobs.

guest_manifest.compressed_texture_blocks: native-supported ETC2/EAC, ASTC LDR and BC
guest_manifest.scope: selected compute, graphics, queries, descriptor templates, Wayland and fixed-display WSI API; not Vulkan conformance or complete Zink

mechanisms: One selected native-field definition governs physical feature queries and host device enablement. Legacy bits 0-6 are preserved; bits 7-21 expose only actual native image/storage/atomic/indexing/indirect/compression support.

Operations 203/204/205 record native draw, indexed-draw and dispatch indirect commands. Original argument-buffer/memory ownership joins the existing command graph, without CPU argument readback/expansion, descriptor rescan or a new synchronization barrier.
Mesa aggregate graphics-shader barrier masks omit only absent geometry/tessellation stages; active producer/consumer stages remain. Individual unsupported stage requests remain rejected.

Native ETC2/EAC, ASTC-LDR and BC paths use block dimensions/bytes for format admission and transfer footprints, including mip edges, row padding, array slices, matching compressed image copies and compatible views.

native_gpu_acceptance.scope: selected GLES 3.1 GPU/ASTC output oracles, not full CTS

gles31_native_follow_up.oracle_chain: Compute shader writes dispatch and both draw records; indirect compute then both indirect draws are recorded before any CPU verification readback. The source argument buffer is deleted before the final readback. Verify compute values, four atomic increments, fragment atomic count and image pixels.
gles31_native_follow_up.astc_oracle: 8x6 ASTC blocks in a 9x7 texture: native upload, 1x1 logical-edge subimage update, image-to-image copy and 63 exact red/green/blue pixels.
gles31_native_follow_up.legacy_pbo_oracle: 128 exact signed/unsigned integer components and two required cross-signedness errors pass on the final pinned-header ICD.
